entry.title: New: Bill 173 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Postponed
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 19, ARTICLE 7, SECTION 19-53 OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY VALUATION; CONSIDERATIONS IN FIXING

Lowers the cap on annual increases to the assessed value for properties in the Homeowner and Affordable Rental Housing tax classifications from three percent to two and a half percent.

Latest action: Council: Bill 173 postponed to the Call of the Chair - 07/10/24; never taken up again
